# simulator.injectCrsfFrame

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Simulate CRSF telemetry received from the external module. The length and the CRC are computed.

```lua
simulator.injectCrsfFrame(frameId, payload)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frameId` | integer | yes |  |
| `payload` | table | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
simulator.injectCrsfFrame(0x08, {0x00, 0x7E, 0x00, 0x0A, 0x00, 0x01, 0xF4, 0x50}) -- Battery: 12.6V, 1.0A, 500mAh, 80%
```
